2608.24467.title: HMGCLIP: Heterogeneous Multi-Granularity Contrastive Learning for E-commerce Representation Learning
2608.24467.paper_summary: Although recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced general product understanding, they implicitly encode product information into global embeddings, thereby limiting their ability to capture fine-grained attributes. This limitation hinders performance in tasks requiring precise attribute discrimination, such as distinguishing subtle material differences among visually similar products. To address this challenge, we propose HMGCLIP, a unified multimodal embedding framework. By constructing a heterogeneous hypergraph, we leverage hypergraph topology to mine structure-aware hard negatives and align multi-granular semantics at both relation and hyperedge levels. This design enables a dual-granularity inference mechanism that dynamically fuses attribute evidence for both fine-grained and coarse-grained downstream tasks. Furthermore, we release a comprehensive fine-grained e-commerce dataset to facilitate future benchmarking. Extensive experiments on this new dataset and the public MAVE benchmark show that HMGCLIP outperforms strong multimodal encoders, MLLMs, and e-commerce baselines, validating the superiority of HMGCLIP.
2608.24467.paper_summary_zh: 儘管最近的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在一般產品理解方面有所進展，但它們將產品信息隱式編碼為全局嵌入，從而限制了它們捕捉細粒度屬性的能力。這一限制妨礙了在需要精確屬性區分的任務中的表現，例如區分視覺上相似產品之間的微妙材料差異。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了HMGCLIP，一個統一的多模態嵌入框架。通過構建異質超圖，我們利用超圖拓撲來挖掘結構感知的困難負樣本，並在關係和超邊層面上對齊多粒度語義。這一設計使得雙粒度推理機制得以實現，動態融合細粒度和粗粒度下游任務的屬性證據。此外，我們發布了一個全面的細粒度電子商務數據集，以促進未來的基準測試。在這個新數據集和公共MAVE基準上的廣泛實驗表明，HMGCLIP的表現超過了強大的多模態編碼器、MLLMs和電子商務基準，驗證了HMGCLIP的優越性。
